dialogue.content: 本日はロールプレイよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for the role-play session today. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。まず初めに性別、年齢、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんばんは高一男です
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a male, first-year high school student.

dialogue.content: 全てに疲れました
dialogue.English: I'm exhausted by everything.

dialogue.content: 全てに疲れてしまったのですね。それはお辛いですね…
dialogue.English: I see, you're feeling exhausted by everything. That must be very tough...

dialogue.content: 本日お話するに当たって何とお呼びすればよいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: For our conversation today, how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: 田中です
dialogue.English: Tanaka.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。田中さんですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Tanaka, is that right?

dialogue.content: 全てに疲れてしまった…とのことですが、どんな時に特に疲れを感じますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned feeling exhausted by everything... Could you tell me when you feel that exhaustion most strongly?

dialogue.content: 全部です家も学校もなにもかも
dialogue.English: Everything. Home, school... just everything.

dialogue.content: 家も学校も疲れてしまったのですね。それは心が休まるときがありませんね…
dialogue.English: So you’re worn out by both home and school. That must mean you have no time for your mind to rest…

dialogue.content: 家と学校それぞれ、どんなことで疲れを感じるか詳しく聞いてもよいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I asked you to elaborate on what makes you feel exhausted at home and at school, respectively?

dialogue.content: 何が嫌なのか考えることこも疲れました
dialogue.English: Even thinking about what's bothering me is exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…考えることにも疲れを感じるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see… So even just thinking feels exhausting for you.

dialogue.content: 考えるのも疲れる…相当お疲れなのですね。
dialogue.English: Thinking itself is exhausting... You must be extremely worn out.

dialogue.content: 田中さんがすべてに疲れると感じるようになったのはいつ頃からかわかりますか？
dialogue.English: Do you know around when you started feeling exhausted by everything, Tanaka-san?

dialogue.content: さぁいつからなんてわかりません受験頑張って行った学校がクソで通学も鬱陶しいし…
dialogue.English: Who knows when it started. I worked hard to get into this school, but it sucks, and the commute is a pain...

dialogue.content: 家も鬱陶しい
dialogue.English: Home is a pain, too.

dialogue.content: 居るところも無いし
dialogue.English: I have nowhere to belong.

dialogue.content: 自由もない
dialogue.English: No freedom, either.

dialogue.content: なんか考えるのも疲れた
dialogue.English: I'm just tired of thinking about it all.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。いつからか疲れると感じるようになったよいう感じでしょうか…居場所も自由もなければ疲れると感じるのも当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. So it sounds like you started feeling this way at some point... It's completely understandable to feel exhausted when you have no place to belong and no freedom.

dialogue.content: 受験を頑張って今の学校に入られたのですね！勉強頑張られたのですね。
dialogue.English: So you worked hard on your entrance exams to get into your current school! You must have studied very hard.

dialogue.content: 頑張って入った学校なのに思っていたのとは違ったという感じですか？
dialogue.English: Does it feel like the school you worked so hard to get into isn't what you expected?

dialogue.content: 学費や交通費を考えたら、そこしかなかったって感じです
dialogue.English: Considering the tuition and transportation costs, it feels like that was the only option.

dialogue.content: 時間ないなか勉強しないと入れなかったから頑張ったけど
dialogue.English: I worked hard because I had to study with little time to get in, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 無理して行く意味ある？って感じです
dialogue.English: It's like I'm thinking, "Is there even a point in forcing myself to go?"

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね…ご家庭のことを考えて学校を選ばれたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so you chose your school with your family's situation in mind.

dialogue.content: そして時間がない中頑張って勉強して今の学校に入って…田中さんが元々入りたいと思った学校ではなかったということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And you studied hard with limited time to get into your current school... Does that mean it wasn't the school you originally wanted to attend, Tanaka-san?

dialogue.content: どこ行きたいとか考えたことない
dialogue.English: I've never thought about where I wanted to go.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 考えたことがないということは、自分では行きたい学校が選べない状況だったのでしょうか…？
dialogue.English: Not having thought about it—does that mean you weren't in a position to choose the school you wanted for yourself?

dialogue.content: そんな自由言える環境と違いますので
dialogue.English: It's not the kind of environment where I can freely say things like that.

dialogue.content: なるほど…先ほども自由がないと言っていましたね。自分の意見が言えないのはなかなか苦しいですよね。保護者の方が厳しいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand... You mentioned earlier that you have no freedom. It must be very difficult not being able to voice your own opinions. Are your parents or guardians strict?

dialogue.content: 厳しくはない
dialogue.English: They're not strict.

dialogue.content: 厳しくはないのですね。自由が言えない環境というのをもう少し詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: They're not strict, I see. Could you tell me a little more about this environment where you can't speak freely?

dialogue.content: 話せるところからで構いません。
dialogue.English: You can start with whatever you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Ummm...

dialogue.content: なかなか言いずらいですよね…金銭関係とかそんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: It can be difficult to talk about... Is it related to finances, something like that?

dialogue.content: おばぁヨボヨボオカン病気おばちゃん働けへんくせにウルサイ
dialogue.English: My grandma's frail, my mom's sick, and my aunt is always loud and complaining even though she doesn't work.

dialogue.content: 以上家族構成でした
dialogue.English: And that's the family lineup.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: おばぁの年金で生活中
dialogue.English: We're living off my grandma's pension.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね…それは自由が言えないと田中さんが言っていたのもよくわかります。
dialogue.English: I see... Now I can really understand why you said you can't speak freely, Tanaka-san.

dialogue.content: 話したくなければ話さなくても大丈夫なのですが…お父さんは？
dialogue.English: You don't have to answer if you don't want to... but what about your father?

dialogue.content: いない
dialogue.English: He's not around.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。田中さんが物ごごろついたときからいないですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Has he been gone for as long as you can remember?

dialogue.content: 最初からいない
dialogue.English: He's been gone from the very beginning.

dialogue.content: 生まれたときから今の環境
dialogue.English: This has been my environment since I was born.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お話してくれてありがとうございます。家族構成がよくわかりました。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me. I have a much clearer picture of your family situation now.

dialogue.content: 田中さんは今の環境で生活をされていて、自由が言えない、居場所がないと感じ疲れてしまったのですね。
dialogue.English: So, living in your current environment, you feel you can't speak freely and don't have a place to belong, and that has left you exhausted.

dialogue.content: 今の状況が少しでも良い方向に向かっていけるよう一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Let's think together about how we can move your current situation in a slightly better direction.

dialogue.content: そんな方法あるの？
dialogue.English: Is there even a way to do that?

dialogue.content: 無いと思うよ
dialogue.English: I don't think so.

dialogue.content: その方法を一緒に考えていければ、田中さんの少しでもお役に立てればと思います。
dialogue.English: I hope that by thinking about a way forward together, I can be of some help to you, Tanaka-san.

dialogue.content: 今お母さんはご病気ということで、おばあさんの年金で田中さんと３人で暮らされていると先ほど話してくださいましたね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that your mother is ill, and that the three of you are living together on your grandmother's pension, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ひとり親の場合、国から支援を受けられます。
dialogue.English: In single-parent households, you can receive support from the government.

dialogue.content: 条件は地方自治体によって様々かと思いますが、
dialogue.English: The eligibility criteria can vary depending on the local municipality, however.

dialogue.content: おばあの年金あるから無理やった微妙に多いみたい
dialogue.English: We couldn't get it because of my grandma's pension. Apparently, the income is just slightly over the limit.

dialogue.content: 生活保護も一緒
dialogue.English: It was the same with welfare.

dialogue.content: ギリギリ上回ってダメやった
dialogue.English: We were just barely over the limit, so it was a no-go.

dialogue.content: 死なんていどには、お金あります。
dialogue.English: We have enough money to not die, I guess.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。色々調べられているんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You've really looked into a lot of options.

dialogue.content: そ
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 役所の人も力になりますって言うてたけど、残念でしたって帰っていった
dialogue.English: The person at the city office said they'd help, but in the end they just left saying it was unfortunate.

dialogue.content: なるほど…それは突き放された気持ちになってしまいますよね。田中さんはいまの状況のここが少しでも変わればなと思うところはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand... that must have made you feel completely brushed aside. Is there any part of your current situation that you wish could change, even just a little?

dialogue.content: 金銭面、家庭環境、学校、、、色々あるとは思いますが、
dialogue.English: It could be about finances, your home environment, school... I imagine there are many things, but...

dialogue.content: それ考えたら疲れた
dialogue.English: Just thinking about it is tiring.

dialogue.content: 死ぬのが一番ラクなんやろけど、俺が死んだら皆死ぬやろし…
dialogue.English: Dying would probably be the easiest way out, but if I die, everyone else will die too...

dialogue.content: そうか…ご自身や家族についてたくさん考えられたのですね。ご家族思いなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... you've thought a lot about yourself and your family. You're very considerate of them.

dialogue.content: そういうわけでもない
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: しゃぁないから
dialogue.English: It's just that I have no choice.

dialogue.content: しゃあないといっても考られていることは素晴らしいと思います。少しでも改善すれば…との思いで、こうやって相談をしにきてくださっていますし。
dialogue.English: Even if you say you have no choice, I think it's wonderful that you're thinking about these things. You've come here to talk today with the hope that things might improve, even just a little.

dialogue.content: こうやって相談にきてくださっている、行動しているということはとても重要なことです。
dialogue.English: The fact that you've come here to talk today, that you've taken this action, is very significant.

dialogue.content: うーんなんで相談してるんやろかせんど相談してきて無理やったのにね
dialogue.English: Hmm, I wonder why I'm even here. I've tried to get help so many times before and it was no use.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 謝らないでください。
dialogue.English: Please don't apologize.

dialogue.content: 田中さんは何も悪くないです。
dialogue.English: You haven't done anything wrong, Tanaka-san.

dialogue.content: あなたに悪いなと思って
dialogue.English: I just feel bad for you.

dialogue.content: 答えの出ないこと相談して、申し訳ないなと
dialogue.English: I feel bad for bringing up a problem that has no answer.

dialogue.content: だって、しゃぁないもんね
dialogue.English: Because it just can't be helped, right?

dialogue.content: わたしはこうやって相談にきてくださっていることが、お話をしてくださったことが嬉しいですし、少しでもお役に立てればと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm just happy that you've come here to talk, that you've shared your story with me, and I hope I can be of some help.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そのしゃあないという気持ちを吐き出してくださったことはとても次に向かうためには大切なことですから。
dialogue.English: Being able to express that feeling of "it can't be helped" is a very important step toward moving forward.

dialogue.content: こうして家族やご自身のためにいっぱい考えて疲れてしまうほどだったのに、ここに相談にくるという行動を起こした自分をまず褒めてあげてもよいのかな？と思いますよ。
dialogue.English: You've thought so much about your family and yourself to the point of exhaustion, and yet you took the step to come here for help. I think you can give yourself credit for that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こうやって田中さんがお話をしてくださっていることで、田中さんのご家庭の状況がわかりました。
dialogue.English: By you talking with me like this, I've come to understand your family's situation, Tanaka-san.

dialogue.content: 本日はお時間となってしまいましたが、またこちらでも田中さんのお役に立つような情報を調べておきますね。
dialogue.English: We're out of time for today, but I will look up some information on my end that might be helpful for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ本日はお話してくださってありがとうございます。また次回ご相談にきてくださった際にお伝えできればと思います。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for talking with me today. I hope to share what I find with you the next time you come for a session.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ここは自由にお話ができる場ですので、気持ちを吐き出しに来るだけでも構いません。またお話しにきていただけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: This is a place where you can talk freely, so it's perfectly fine to come just to vent your feelings. I hope you'll come and talk with me again.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それまではお話できないことは、ノートに書きこむなど、自分であまりため込まないようにしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Until then, for things you can’t talk about, try writing them down in a notebook or something so you don’t bottle them up too much.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それまではこちらで終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: We will conclude the session here for now.

dialogue.content: (お疲れさまでした。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.content: (時間をオーバーしてしまい申し訳ございません。本日はお付き合いいただき、ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (I apologize for going over time. Thank you for your participation today.)
